classification: preregistered stock, asset and ETF liquidity concentration audit of the R325 passing candidate; no strategy parameter changes
question: R325 的权益复合袖 + 黄金 ETF 风险预算是否把收益集中在少数股票、单一行业或黄金资产本身？黄金 ETF 的成交额、权重和换手是否足以进入纸面执行复核？

candidate.equity: R312 A/B 60d inverse-vol risk parity, A bounds [0.2,0.8], then 15% vol target [0.2,1.0]
candidate.portfolio: R324/R325 60d inverse-vol between equity composite and gold, equity asset-weight bounds [0.2,0.8], 15% total-vol target, gross [0.2,1.0], monthly, no leverage

attribution.stock_pnl: each A/B trade pnl_amount multiplied by its holding-period average effective stock sleeve weight = R325 equity asset weight * A/B share
attribution.gold_pnl: monthly approximation = portfolio NAV at rebalance * target gold asset weight * gold ETF monthly qfq return; summed over months
attribution.gold_contribution_share: approximate gold PnL / (approximate gold PnL + scaled stock trade PnL)
attribution.limitation: This is a contribution-share approximation, not a compounded attribution ledger; allocator costs, cash carry and intra-month weight drift are not separately allocated.

gates.C2_top1: largest positive stock-symbol net P&L share <=25%
gates.C3_top3: top three positive stock-symbol net P&L share <=55%
gates.C4_top5: top five positive stock-symbol net P&L share <=75%
gates.C5_recent_breadth: at least 8 distinct recent-12m stock symbols with positive attributed P&L
gates.C7_loss: largest single-stock loss <=20% of stock gross profit
gates.C8_gold_contribution: approximate gold PnL share <=75% of total approximate stock + gold PnL
gates.C9_gold_weight: mean monthly target gold weight <=55% and maximum monthly target gold weight <=75%
gates.C10_etf_liquidity: gold ETF coverage >=95% of aligned dates, median daily amount >=100 million CNY, and minimum 20-day average amount >=50 million CNY
gates.C12_no_leverage: all monthly target equity + gold weights are nonnegative and their sum <=1.0

selection_rule: C1-C12 all pass -> candidate_for_paper_trading_review only. Any failure -> research_only_concentration_failed. No weight, gold ETF, window, cost or threshold changes after seeing results.
known_limitations: Industry classification is a current snapshot, not historical PIT.
Stock PnL scaling and gold PnL decomposition are approximate contribution shares.
Gold ETF qfq prices and amounts are provider-reconstructed, not an official PIT archive.
R40 local research data, current factor versions and canonical data drift remain unresolved.
A pass does not authorize production; it only permits a separate paper-execution audit.
